coverage_policy.note: Per-task overall coverage only. T4 uses 0.5 to retain missing-resource symptoms of a stopped instance. Always report per-fault retention and sensitivity; missing is never zero.

eligible_semantics: syntactic/time/coverage eligibility only; not proof of predictability or effect
main_split: W1 train D01-D04 / validation D05 / previously used test D06-D07; not chronological

index_contract.rows: zero-based [start_row,stop_row) in immutable per-run core_features_5s; 12 rows; same run only
index_contract.labels: T1: y_host_cpu_pct,y_upf_silver_cpu_millicores,y_upf_gold_cpu_millicores; other tasks y; all label/index fields excluded from X

T2_normal_train_rule: clean entire history (no active/recovery/prelude) AND split=train AND eligible; score validation/test with frozen threshold
T3_history_rule: clean entire history (no active/recovery/prelude); exclude nearest onset <10s, current active/recovery, and incomplete future; all real episodes considered incl prelude exclusion
T4_scope: upf: main UPF episodes; six: main core_count episodes only; root-cause labels indicate injection target/path, not independent causal proof
package_content: plan, observations, task indices/labels, loader and checks; full deep-learning trainers are to be implemented/run on target machine
coverage_basis: W1 uses frozen formal bounds; non-W1 uses previously parsed observation spans, not lifecycle-certified official run bounds
